answers.why: Israel is the people for whom the LORD performed the works witnessed by Joshua's generation.
The new generation did not know the works the LORD had done for their people Israel.
Israel is delivered to plunderers and described with plural pronouns as facing their enemies.
The LORD explicitly calls Israel this nation that transgressed his covenant.
Israel is tested to see whether they will obey as their fathers did.
Israel comprises those who had not experienced the wars of Canaan.
Israel is tested for obedience to commandments given to their fathers through Moses.
Othniel judges Israel and goes to war to deliver the people.
Eglon is strengthened against Israel because the Israelites had done evil.
Eglon's allied forces defeat Israel and occupy the city of palm trees.
Moab is subdued under Israel after the Israelites defeat its warriors.
Shamgar delivers Israel by killing six hundred Philistines.
